description_sq:
Fresku = Shitet Bar/Restaurant 155m2 tek rruga "Muhamet Deliu" 
Restauranti eshte totalisht i investuar dhe ka vite ne tregun e kulinarise. 
Kuzhine e kompletuar, banak i kompletuar dhe mobilimi eshte bere totalisht vitin qe kaloi. Totali i investimit shkon ne 60k euro. 
Restauanti ndodhet ne katin 0 te nje pallati te vitit 2012 dhe ne Corner te pallatit. Per personat e interesuar ne investim ky vend lihet me qera lehtesiht 1300 euro/muaj.
description_en: Fresku = Bar/Restaurant 155m2 for sale on "Muhamet Deliu" street. The restaurant is fully invested and has been in the culinary market for years. Complete kitchen, complete counter and furniture was completely done last year. The total investment amounts to 60k euros. The restaurant is located on the 0th floor of a building built in 2012 and in the corner of the building. For people interested in investing, this place is easily rented for 1300 euros/month.
